title: Clone Captain Rex
description: Grown on Kamino like his fellow clone troopers and bred to be among the best soldiers in the galaxy, Rex served on the front lines of the Clone Wars. Working directly with Anakin Skywalker and Ahsoka Tano, he viewed his service as an honor and had deep respect for the Jedi he served. Once Order 66 was executed, Ahsoka helped him remove his inhibitor chip, freeing him from the need to kill Jedi.
